task_instance: Set up the full Python quality-gate system described by the py-quality-gates skill in a small sample repo: a src/sampleproj package with calc.py and a tests/ suite, pyproject.toml tool configs (ruff lint+format, pytest, coverage), a check.sh orchestrator running all gates, and a .pre-commit-config.yaml wired through prek with a fast pre-commit hook and a full pre-push hook; then verify the gate actually runs and passes/fails correctly.
evidence: Runtime: Python 3.13.17, uv and poetry present; created a venv at <work>/.venv and installed ruff 0.17.3, radon 6.0.1, vulture 2.16, pylint 4.1.3, pytest 9.2.0, ty 0.0.95, and prek 0.5.9 (all via pip inside the work-dir venv, quiet mode). Built a sample project: src/sampleproj/{__init__.py,calc.py}, tests/test_calc.py. Wrote pyproject.toml ([tool.ruff]/[tool.ruff.lint] with select E,W,F,I,N,UP,B,SIM,TCH,RUF; [tool.ruff.format]; [tool.pytest.ini_options] with pythonpath=['src']; [tool.coverage.run]/report/json). The skill's Step 4 coverage header was a scrubbed placeholder; used the correct [tool.coverage.run] section. Wrote and chmod+x check.sh (adapted RUN='' for the activated venv, SRC_DIR='src', ty as type checker; added '|| true' so run_gate collects all failures instead of aborting under set -e, final summary still exits 1 on any failure). Wrote .pre-commit-config.yaml (fast hook ./check.sh --fast on pre-commit; full ./check.sh on pre-push,manual) and a CLAUDE.md Quality Gates section. Verification: './check.sh' ran every gate (ruff lint, ruff format, file length, ty type check, pytest+coverage, per-file coverage, radon cc, radon mi, vulture, pylint duplicate) and ended 'All checks passed' EXIT=0; coverage reported 83.33% total. Negative test: inserting an unused 'import os' into calc.py made the ruff-lint gate report F401 and './check.sh --fast' exit 1 (then restored the file). Wired prek against a local 'git init' repo: 'prek install --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type pre-push' installed both .git/hooks; 'prek run --all-files' ran the fast gate -> Passed; 'prek run --all-files --hook-stage pre-push' ran the full gate -> Passed. All work and installs stayed inside the work directory; no external writes, no network package fetch beyond pip into the local venv, no connectors/MCP.
